blocks.heading: Pages and blocks
blocks.body:
An AEM **page** has a template and a stack of **blocks**. Adobe’s ready-made blocks are called **Core Components** :  Title, Text, Image, Teaser, and more. You insert them. You do not build them this week.

A **DITA topic** is a whole file with a type (explaining page, how-to, lookup). It is not a block. Do not paste a how-to into a Text block and call the landing page the handbook.

blocks.q: A Text block on a landing page is where you should paste the prime-the-pump how-to. True or not?
options: Not true. How-to pages belong in Oxygen. A landing page can tease the product. It does not become the handbook
True if the block is named Task
blocks.why: Two desks. A block is a piece of a web page. A topic is a whole help file.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: What is a component in AEM, in one line?
options: A block on the page :  Title, Text, Image. Adobe ships a ready-made set of these blocks
blocks.why: Component means block. The page is a stack of them on a template.

blocks.q: Are you building a new block type today?
options: No :  authors insert ready-made blocks. Developers build new types
blocks.why: Author week. Next week you place Text, Image, Teaser as an author. You do not implement them.
